title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray, implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 2.1: Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic well-being. The activities and objective includes Facilitate research on viability of pastoral livelihood in the face of climate change and require policy and practice shifts; support education on climate change to empower advocacy in pastoralists, agro pastoralists and school clubs, strengthen value chain coordination platforms between stakeholders and support women to engage in market advocacy initiatives. So, groups are collaborating initiatives for the sustainable management and governance of natural resources nationally and internationally. Programmes are in partnership with Sodo Catholic Secretariat, Organization for Women in Self Employment (WISE) and Association of Pastoralist community for change. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:- Evidence-based climate change advocacy and networking in the national, regional & international climate justice arenas. - Supporting local voices to advocate for the protection of their natural resources and influencing national and international policy- Climate adaptation is linked to biodiversity because by protecting and restoring biodiversity, we strengthen the resilience of our ecosystems and the communities we work with to the impacts of climate change- Policy work at national and international level on climate finance, support for Agroecology and promotion of renewables are directly linked to climate mitigation
